 Oral Judgment

1. This appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and award dated 14.02.2019 in MVC No.997/2016 by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Vijayapura (for short 'the tribunal') seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The injured-claimant filed claim petition before the tribunal claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- along with interest.
The petition was dismissed by the tribunal on the ground of territorial jurisdiction.
The claimant stated that, he met with accident on 16.09.2015 in Pune Road and he has not filed any document to show that, he is resident of Vijayapura.
Aggrieved by the said order the claimant preferred the present appeal and filed I.A.No.1/2022 for NC: 2025:KHC-K:6548 HC-KAR production of additional documents i.e. Adhar card to prove his residence.
On perusal of the Adhar card, it shows that it was issued way back 28.12.2011 i.e. four years prior to the 10.12.2021.

The claimant had not produced the Adhar card before the tribunal at the earliest point of time and as such, now the claimant has filed an application for production of additional document i.e. Adhar card.
Therefore, he is not entitled for interest from the date of petition till the filing of the application i.e. on 19.01.2022 to receive additional document.

3. In view of the above, from the date of petition till filing of the application i.e. 19.01.2022, the interest is denied and the matter is remitted back to the tribunal with a specific direction to grant sufficient opportunity to both sides to lead evidence and to submit arguments and the tribunal is directed to dispose of the matter on merits within a period of three months from the date of this order.
